final: WITH per_category AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS average_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS average_total FROM per_category) SELECT p.category, p.average_remaining, p.total, p.total - o.average_total AS above_average FROM per_category AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.total > o.average_total
